mapper.select: SELECT seller_id AS sellerId, email, password, representative_name AS representativeName, status, reg_date AS regDate FROM seller WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY seller_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE seller SET status = #{status} WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seller WHERE status = 'PENDING'
SELECT brand_id FROM brand WHERE brand_name = #{brandName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (product_id, category_id, brand_id, product_name, price, description, original_price, discount_rate, created, updated, status) VALUES (product_seq.NEXTVAL, #{categoryId}, #{brandId}, #{productName}, #{price}, #{description}, #{originalPrice}, #{discountRate}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.brand_id AS brandId, p.product_name AS productName, p.price, p.description, p.original_price AS originalPrice, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, b.brand_name AS brandName FROM product p JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET category_id = #{categoryId}, brand_id = #{brandId}, product_name = #{productName}, price = #{price}, description = #{description}, original_price = #{originalPrice}, discount_rate = #{discountRate}, updated = SYSDATE WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO option_group (option_group_id, product_id, group_name, sort_order, required) VALUES (option_group_seq.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, #{groupName}, #{sortOrder}, #{required})
INSERT INTO option_value (option_value_id, option_group_id, option_name, sort_order) VALUES (option_value_seq.NEXTVAL, #{optionGroupId}, #{optionName}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT option_group_id AS optionGroupId, product_id AS productId, group_name AS groupName, sort_order AS sortOrder, required FROM option_group WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT option_value_id AS optionValueId, option_group_id AS optionGroupId, option_name AS optionName, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM option_value WHERE option_group_id = #{optionGroupId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_option (product_option_id, product_id, sku, price, stock, status) VALUES (product_option_seq.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, #{sku}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{status})
INSERT INTO product_option_value (product_option_value_id, product_option_id, option_value_id) VALUES (product_option_value_seq.NEXTVAL, #{productOptionId}, #{optionValueId})
mapper.select: SELECT product_option_id AS productOptionId, product_id AS productId, sku, price, stock, status FROM product_option WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY product_option_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_image (image_id, product_id, image_url, image_type, sort_order) VALUES (seq_product_image.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageType}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE brand_id = #{brandId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT p.product_id FROM product p JOIN product_option po ON p.product_id = po.product_id WHERE p.brand_id = #{brandId} GROUP BY p.product_id HAVING SUM(po.stock) = 0 )

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.brand_id AS brandId, p.product_name AS productName, p.price, p.description, p.original_price AS originalPrice, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, p.status, p.created, p.updated, NVL(SUM(po.stock), 0) AS totalStock FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_option po ON p.product_id = po.product_id WHERE p.brand_id = #{brandId} GROUP BY p.product_id, p.category_id, p.brand_id, p.product_name, p.price, p.description, p.original_price, p.discount_rate, p.status, p.created, p.updated ORDER BY p.product_id DESC

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.brand_id AS brandId, b.brand_name AS brandName, p.product_name AS productName, p.price, p.status, p.created FROM product p JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id ORDER BY p.product_id DESC

UPDATE product_option SET price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, status = CASE WHEN #{stock} = 0 THEN 'SOLD_OUT' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND sku = #{skuName}
